10 Days / 9 Nights

Spiti Circuit & Chandratal Lake Moto-Expedition

Delhi — Manali — Jibhi — Sangla — Kalpa — Kaza — Chandratal — Manali — Delhi

About This Trip

Loading overview...

Itinerary

Board an overnight Volvo bus from Delhi to Manali. Settle in for a comfortable journey towards the mountains.

Arrive in Manali, collect and test-ride bikes for riders, and transfer to Jibhi/Gushaini. Check in, explore the valley, dinner, and overnight stay.

Enjoy a relaxed morning exploring Jibhi's waterfalls and local cafes before preparing for the high-altitude leg ahead.

Drive 8 hours via Rampur to Sangla Valley. Visit Chitkul, the last inhabited village of India near the Indo-China border.

Ride 4-5 hours to Kalpa. Visit the famous Suicide Point, witness the breathtaking sunset over the Kinner Kailash range, and stay overnight.

Drive along the Hindustan-Tibet Highway. See Khab confluence, Reo Purgyil view, Malling Nallah, and the 500-year-old mummy at Gue. Overnight in Kaza.

Visit the world's highest post office at Hikkim, highest motorable village at Komic, and Langza Buddha statue under Chau Chau Kang Nelda peak.

Drive via Key Monastery, Kibber village, Chicham Bridge, and Kunzum Pass. Trek the last 1 km to the crescent-shaped Chandratal Lake. Overnight at campsite.

Ride 7-8 hours from Chandratal to Manali passing Batal, Chattru, and through the iconic Atal Tunnel. Overnight in Manali.

Self-exploration in Manali during the day. Board the overnight Volvo bus back to Delhi in the evening.
